question: Which platform is used for submitting ideas under the INSPIRE MANAK Scheme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**INSPIRE Portal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **INSPIRE MANAK Scheme** is implemented by the Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India, to strengthen the innovation culture among school students.
 
• The platform for submitting ideas under this scheme is the official **INSPIRE Portal**.
 
• The portal allows students from grades 6 to 10 to submit their innovative ideas through their schools.
 
• The **INSPIRE MANAK Award** is given to students whose ideas are selected for funding and further development.
 
• The scheme aims to encourage creativity and critical thinking by recognizing and nurturing innovative ideas at a young age.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **INSPIRE Programme:**

 
 
• INSPIRE stands for **Innovation in Science Pursuit for Inspired Research**.
 
• It is an initiative by the Department of Science and Technology (DST) to attract talent to the study of science.
 
• The programme includes various components such as scholarships, internships, and awards for students and researchers.
 
 
 
• **MANAK Scheme:**
 
 
• MANAK stands for **Million Minds Augmenting National Aspirations and Knowledge**.
 
• It focuses on encouraging students to address societal problems through science and technology-based solutions.
 
• Around 2 lakh ideas are shortlisted annually, and top innovations are showcased at the national level.
 
 
 
• **Submission Process:**
 
 
• Students need to register their ideas online through the INSPIRE Portal.
 
• Schools act as facilitators in the submission process.
 
• The ideas are evaluated based on originality, societal impact, and scientific feasibility.
 
 
 
• **Support and Recognition:**
 
 
• Selected students receive a cash award and mentorship for developing prototypes.
 
• The best innovations are showcased in exhibitions and events organized by DST.
